title: Auto Farm , Auto Chest , More
features:
⚔️ Combat & Farm

Dungeon Auto: Auto Loot / Auto Open Chests & Altars / Auto Complete Dungeon

Enemy: Kill Aura (Distance Slider) / Auto Target Nearest Enemy

Boss: Auto Boss Farm / Boss Detection

🛒 Shop & Stats

Auto Spend: Auto Spend Stat Points

Quick Actions: Reset Stats / Max Stats / Respec Buttons

👁️ Visuals & ESP

Master Toggle: Enable/Disable all ESP

Filters: Enemies ESP / Bosses ESP / Chests & Altars / Players ESP / Combat Dummies ESP

Elements: Bounding Box (Style Dropdown) / Name Tags / Health Bars / Distance Text / Tracers (Origin Dropdown) / Chams & Highlights

Range: Max ESP Distance Slider

World: Fullbright / Lighting Modifiers

Colors: Custom ESP Colors per category

🏃 Player & Move

Movement: WalkSpeed Toggle & Slider / JumpPower Toggle & Slider / Infinite Jump

Fly & Clip: Fly Toggle & Speed Slider / Noclip

Misc: Anti-AFK

🗺️ Teleports

Lobby Portals: Area Dropdown + Teleport Button

NPCs & Combat TP: NPC Dropdown + TP Button / Teleport to Nearest Enemy / Teleport to Chest
